title: detect_language result
description: Output of the detect_language MCP tool: the language of one text, typically parse_email_thread's latest_message.text, so the draft can be written in the customer's language. Undecided means resolved_language falls back to the caller's fallback language.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code, lowercase. Null when status is undecided.

status.description: undecided: fewer than four words after removing placeholders, URLs, addresses and tokens with digits (8 characters in Chinese, Japanese, Thai, Lao, Khmer, Myanmar); the top language under 0.9 probability; or a language without an ISO 639-1 code.

ranking.description: The detector's top languages, most likely first; dialect labels summed into their language (ary, arz -> ar). Empty when the text is too short.

language.description: ISO 639-1 where one exists, else the py3langid code.

resolved_language.description: The language to write the draft in: `language` when status is detected; otherwise the `fallback` argument, lowercased, when it is an ISO 639-1 code; otherwise null. Equals `language` when no fallback is given. A key of its own, so a workflow that merges tool results into one context keeps it when a later step writes `language`.
